title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 57
paragraphs: As for the Hellenic race, it has always used the same language, as I clearly perceive, ever since it first took its rise. But since the time when it branched off—feeble at first—from the Pelasgian race, starting from a small beginning it has grown into the great number of peoples that we now see, chiefly because many barbarian peoples have been added to it besides. Moreover it is true, I think, of the Pelasgian race as well, that insofar as it remained barbarian, it never made any great increase.
